candidate_binding: Exact reviewed candidate artifact and SHA256, regenerated from recorded robot bases, tool axes and fixed source geometry.
capture_contract: Before plus each of8 stage boundaries: clean synchronized head/left-wrist/right-wrist RGB, raw robot measurement and camera calibration, all hashes, unchanged physics during capture.
operator_review: No closing and no live wait. Root/operator reviews both endpoint image sets after clean exit. Later full characterization still requires its own fresh three-view gates.

code_proposal.bootstrap: Reuse existing isolated UID65534 startup, private token/tmp/log paths, pinned manifests/dependencies, GPU identity, reset, monitor, stock-fast preclose and parent cleanup. No monkeypatching or fabricated lifecycle.
code_proposal.plan: Separate strict8-stage preview builder/validator. Existing39-stage builder and960 gate stay unchanged until a separately reviewed full-plan revision.
code_proposal.authorization: Distinct robodojo-open-clearance-preview-authorization-1 schema, exact260 ceiling, open-only flag, candidate/plan/program hashes, model/benchmark/full-test false. Disabled by default. Use a distinct preview child authorization environment flag; never interpret it as the full characterization flag.
code_proposal.dispatch: Pass the validated per-mode ceiling explicitly. Enforce both actual ee arrays exactly[1.0] before every neutral observer call; reject all non-open commands before dispatch. Preserve all per-action lead/native/robot guards and ten-substep receipts. Recheck the actual normalized ee arrays inside the neutral observer authorization callback, not only during plan or command generation.
code_proposal.evidence: Separate preview result/preclose schemas and filenames, clearance_preview_completed flag, controller_characterization_completed:false. Full parent/bundle validators must reject preview evidence. Distinct preview launch and preparation schemas as well as result and preclose schemas.
code_proposal.supervision: Same PID/start-tick ownership, bounded deadline, no retries, no signals for passing exit, actual GPU release and before/after source hashes.

required_tests: Default full mode still requires39 stages/960 actions and rejects preview schemas/counts.
Preview admits exactly8 stages/260 actions and rejects any closing command or extra action.
Non-open command rejected at the final authorization/dispatch boundary before native action.
Scope/candidate hash changes fail closed; no policy/model/full-test authorization.
Parent verifies260 receipts/2600 substeps,27 images, isolation, preclose, GPU identities and release.
Existing controller characterization/supervision regressions still pass.
Last-five endpoint pose/open-finger conditions are required; drift or absent stability rejects preview without added actions.
limitations: Numerical paths and image projections screen candidates; they do not prove collision/contact clearance.
Preview does not complete gripper timing or the960-action characterization.
No task success or Standard readiness claim.

endpoint_acceptance.failure_behavior: Preserve receipts and fail closed; no added wait/steps/retry.
